text: The fragile, moist curd is ladled with little cutting and left to drain by itself. Repeated washing with marc de Bourgogne water during at least four weeks develops the brick-red colour and pungent aroma of the rind.

steps.note: The curd is put into cylinders of 95–115 mm (250–350 g) or 165–190 mm (700–1100 g).
The cheese is washed with water containing marc de Bourgogne, a grape spirit, as it ripens.
